question: What supreme benefit is declared for the practice associated with the blue-bodied deity?
premises: A supreme teaching concerning the blue-bodied deity is declared.
This teaching has a specific fruit.
The fruit is the accomplishment of all aims.
inference: The supreme teaching of the blue-bodied deity grants the accomplishment of all aims.
uncertainties: The exact referent of nīla+tanoḥ is inferred from context as Nīla Sarasvatī.
plain_english: The supreme teaching concerning the blue-bodied deity is declared to grant the accomplishment of all aims.
